command: set -eu; test -n "$$DEMO_PG_PASSWORD"; pg_ctl -D "$$PGDATA" -o "-c listen_addresses=''" -w start >/dev/null; rc=0; printf "ALTER ROLE openbinding PASSWORD :'pw';\n" | psql -U openbinding -d openbinding -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -v pw="$$DEMO_PG_PASSWORD" >/dev/null || rc=$$?; pg_ctl -D "$$PGDATA" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null; test "$$rc" -eq 0; echo pg-role-password-reset-ok
